messages:
Ravi: FYI - Clearinghouse asked for a concise SLA appendix for their renewal packet. They want clear credit tiers, example invoices, and a note on onboarding exceptions. Can we review approach? @June @Liam
June: I can take the doc. Quick clarifying q: they have a hybrid setup (hosted primary + failover dedicated). Recommend separate SLO lines but single credit table.
Liam: Agree. Suggest SLOs: hosted 99.95% monthly uptime, p95 <= 200ms; dedicated 99.99%, p95 <= 120ms. Credits should be tiered (small, medium, large outages) instead of a single proportional formula. Easier for sales to explain.
Asha: Sales note - Clearinghouse cares a lot about predictable exposure. If we do tiers, cap total monthly credit at 8% and add a quarterly safety cap of 12%. Also allow a one-time month-1 waiver during onboarding.
Priya: Finance needs worked USD examples. Monthly invoice ~ $48,000 for their committed throughput. Please show 0.5% (minor), 3% (moderate), and 7% (severe) credit examples.
Liam: Draft calc snippet: ```
# Tiered credit pseudo
if downtime_minutes <= 10: credit_pct = 0.5
elif downtime_minutes <= 60: credit_pct = 3
else: credit_pct = 7
credit_amount = min(monthly_bill * credit_pct/100, monthly_bill * cap_pct/100)
```
Ravi: Also include rolling-window rule: we calculate credits per billing period (monthly) and apply quarterly cap if cumulative credits exceed threshold. Spell out "what we don't cover" (customer network, customer-managed infra).
IncBot: Incident recorded: INC-2022-990 - 2102345800 - us-west: autoscaling delay -> ~18m degraded calls to hosted pool.
June: Noted. I'll put the 18m example into the doc: that maps to the moderate tier (3%) for this month's calc.
Priya: Example invoices to include: 48,000 monthly fee -> 0.5% = $240; 3% = $1,440; 7% = $3,360. Also show line item: "Service Credit (SLA) - USD -$1,440". Add a note about pro rata for partial months.
Asha: Ops/escalations: add P0 channel, 1h initial response for P0, 8h remediation SWAT window, exec escalation if monthly credit >5% or repeated two-month hits.
Ravi: Action list: @June draft one-page SLA appendix with tier table + examples, @Liam add formulas and sample JSON payload for telemetry export, @Priya produce sample invoice lines and wording, @Asha confirm escalation blurb. Target: first draft by Tuesday EOD.
June: I'll drop the draft to drive and ping here. Planning to include a tiny flowchart for how we calculate tier determination (automated telemetry then manual verification).
Priya: Also add billing assumptions: 30-day months, UTC time, rounding rules, and dispute window 60 days.
Ravi: Perfect. Small ask: add a plain-English summary paragraph at top for the renewal pack. Keep everything short. :white_check_mark:
